items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: Well I didn't know too much about him.

ctx.x: Nelson and Eddie Summers. I mean them your favorite fellas. Yeah. In the old days. In the old days. What favorite music that I liked the best? Well in the street my favorite trumpet player was Manuel Perez and Red Allen in the street. That's my favorite trumpet player. Manuel Perez, Red Allen, Willie Pazio and so he's living in Nightward, Maurice Duran. And then later on when Guy Kelly came here, I used to like to hear Guy play too because he could blow. He was very powerful in the street you see. And a powerful…
he fled a car that day. Well you didn't know too much about Joe Watkins and he was pretty a famous client. Yeah. Well I didn't know too much about him. I

know a lot about George Boyd and Zeb because I used to play with George Boyd at the Willow Inn. Me, George Boyd, Udell, Willie Dennis Boyd, and when George Boyd couldn't come he used to send John Casper. Well back in that time John was. John John started to play clarinet jack. He was playing for his flat clarinet. George Boyd just had to you know beg him sometimes to go at his place because I mean he didn't think he'd be playing behind George Boyd but he used to play
